correctness.rationale: Diagonalizing the SPD Hessian gives the exact three-state scalar matrix and cubic characteristic polynomial in the package. Independent symbolic Schur reduction reproduces \(1+u+v=a/(1+\beta)>0\) and shows that the active condition is \(a<2(1-\beta)/(1+2\beta_0)\), while the \(|v|<1\) constraint is weaker. Substituting \(a=\eta_0(1-\beta)h\) cancels \(\beta=\beta_1^2\). At equality the polynomial has root \(-1\); above it a real root lies below \(-1\). The base-rate formula follows from the source noise normalization and decreases from \(2\) to \(\sqrt2\). The standard positive-learning-rate domain is essential: zero learning rate is not claimed stable.

final_claim: For Positive-Negative Momentum on a deterministic SPD quadratic with positive constant learning rate, a curvature mode \(h\) is Schur stable exactly when \(\eta_0h<2/(1+2\beta_0)\); hence full stability is governed by the top curvature, is independent of \(\beta_1\), and the source normalization still leaves the stated monotone stability tax as noise amplification grows.
limitations: Positive constant learning rate, deterministic SPD quadratics and source regime \(\beta_0\ge0\), \(0\le\beta_1<1\) only.
No stochastic mean-square or nonlinear-global stability statement is made.
